status: CORRECTION -- D0 does NOT decompose the frozen gate value
classification: self-caught before reporting; D0's replay itself is verified CORRECT, the earlier framing of what it measures was wrong
what_was_claimed: D0's docstring and my report claimed it 'decomposes the frozen metric' margin_B_bits = -0.0309, by replaying z1's pole-B trajectory.
what_is_actually_true: The frozen evaluator's action_identity aggregation (eval_exp2_k2_terminal.py main(), the action_seed accumulator) is keyed ONLY by seed, inside a loop over ALL 8 policy x pole cells (z0|A, z0|B, z1|A, z1|B, pi_A|A, pi_A|B, pi_B|A, pi_B|B). So the frozen per-seed margin_B_bits POOLS decision points from all 8 rollout trajectories for that seed, not from z1|B alone.
how_this_was_caught: reconstructing the frozen per-seed value from D0's z1|B-only rows gave a mean |difference| of 0.135 against the actual frozen action_identity_by_seed.csv, with eligible_heads differing by up to 3874 -- structurally impossible under a single 240-step, <=4-heads/step episode (max 960). Frozen eligible_heads/seed averages 3965; 3965/8 = 496, matching D0's own z1|B-only average of 520 closely. That ratio confirms 8-way pooling rather than a computational bug.
why_D0_is_not_invalidated: D0's replay was independently verified: same checkpoints (SHA-checked), same fixed_latent_strategy forcing, same build_env/seed, same action_identity() call. The numbers it produces are CORRECT for the quantity it actually computes -- margin_B-style identity evaluated specifically on the trajectory z1 produces when actually deployed on pole B. That is a real, well-defined, arguably MORE decision-relevant quantity than the frozen gate's cross-cell pooled average, because it isolates exactly the states the assigned mode visits in its own role, rather than blending in states visited under z0|A, pi_A|A, pi_B|A, etc.
corrected_label_for_D0s_quantity: margin_B-style identity ON Z1's OWN POLE-B TRAJECTORY -- a targeted diagnostic, distinct from and not a decomposition of the frozen -0.0309 pooled gate value.
does_not_change: D0's collected rows or the seed-level bootstrap procedure
